channel.title: Open Calls for Artists — Monographica
channel.description: Curated list of open calls for photographers and visual artists. Exhibitions, grants, residencies, and publications worldwide.

item.title: Multi-Exposed
item.description: Explores time overlaps and memory through photography. Exhibition: April 18 - May 16, 2026 in Minneapolis, MN. — Deadline: March 22, 2026. Fee: Free for new members. Prize: Exhibition + Directors' Choice award.

item.title: Linkshouse Residency — Pier Arts Centre Orkney
item.description: Month-long funded residency at Linkshouse in Birsay, Orkney, May 1–31, 2026. Partnership with Wilhelmina Barns-Graham Trust and Pier Arts Centre. Includes accommodation, £2,200 stipend, and travel bursary up to £250. On-site artist support and opportunity for future exhibitions with VAS. VAS membership required. — Deadline: March 22, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: £2,200 stipend + accommodation.

item.title: Premio Mila 2026
item.description: Supporting Italian or Italy-based artists under 40. Five finalists exhibited in Milan; winner receives €3,000 acquisition prize with work entering permanent collection. — Deadline: March 22, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: €3,000.

item.title: Creatura Magazine Issue 02 — What We Call Home
item.description: Open call for Issue 02 of this indie print magazine exploring the idea of home — not only as a physical space but as an emotional territory. Selected photographs featured in a collective section of the print edition. — Deadline: March 22, 2026. Fee: €15. Prize: Publication in print edition.

item.title: CPG Mentorship Programme 2026
item.description: 1:1 mentoring programme pairing artists with established photographers, curators, and mediators for four meetings over six months (May–October 2026), in person or online. Mentees receive CHF 500 project support and free access to two online masterclasses. 2026 mentors include Hannah Darabi, Yann Mingard, Abdo Shanan, Holly Roussell, Jermaine Francis, and others. Open to professional artists and photographers (including self-taught) not enrolled in another programme or academic course. Fluency required in one of: French, English, Italian, Arabic, German, Farsi, or Mandarin. — Deadline: March 22, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: CHF 500.

item.title: Lobster Club Artist Residency 2026
item.description: Weeklong summer residency (June 1–8) at Camp Singers in Delhi, New York — 88 acres with restored 1870s lodge. Group show in NYC opening June 10. All disciplines welcome. Simple application: photos of work and a brief about your plans. — Deadline: March 23, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Foto Tallinn 2026 Art Fair
item.description: Estonia's only international art fair dedicated to contemporary photography. September 18-20, 2026 at Kai Art Centre in Tallinn. — Deadline: March 23, 2026. Fee: See application PDF. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Whimsical
item.description: Seeking work that surprises, delights, and transports viewers through playful storytelling, surreal elements, and unexpected juxtapositions. — Deadline: March 23, 2026. Fee: $35. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: 10x10 Photobooks Research Grants Cycle 5
item.description: Three $2,500 grants supporting research on photobooks from Africa and its diaspora. — Deadline: March 23, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $2,500.

item.title: Fast Forward: Analog Photography as a Third Space
item.description: Analog-only submissions exploring how photography creates space for camaraderie and interaction. Darkroom prints and experimental work welcome. — Deadline: March 24, 2026. Fee: $25–$200. Prize: None listed.

item.title: The Magic of Light - Photography Open Call
item.description: Film, digital, and alternative process photography including hybrid approaches. Exhibited in Los Angeles, CA. — Deadline: March 25, 2026. Fee: $45 for up to 5 images. Prize: None listed.

item.title: The Human Portrait
item.description: Global online exhibit honoring portraiture in all its forms — documentary, fine art, street, conceptual, experimental, self-portraiture, and beyond. Seeking portraits that convey presence, emotion, tension, or quiet recognition. $20 for first image, $5 each additional, up to 20 images total. No AI-generated imagery. — Deadline: March 25, 2026. Fee: $20. Prize: $1,000.

item.title: Brussels Street Photography Festival 2026
item.description: International street photography competition with Singles and Series tracks. Singles: up to 10 individual photos. Series: 5–7 cohesive street photos. Winners exhibited at the festival in Brussels, May 28–31, 2026. — Deadline: March 25, 2026. Fee: €12–€45. Prize: €4,150.

item.title: BOTANICAL Photography Exhibit
item.description: Beyond documentation — seeking character in a leaf, architecture in a seedpod. All styles and processes welcome. Santa Fe, NM. — Deadline: March 26, 2026. Fee: $40–$45. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Photographic Exploration Project: ENTANGLEMENT
item.description: Explores intricate webs of connections from intimate relationships to global systems. Group exhibition at Loop Raum in Berlin, July 2026. — Deadline: March 26, 2026. Fee: €5–€15. Prize: None listed.

item.title: MUSE Photography Awards 2026
item.description: International photography competition across 14+ categories including Fine Art, Commercial, Nature, People, Minimalist, Editorial, B&W, Architecture, Fashion, and Mobile. Professional and Amateur/Student divisions. Winners featured on Muse.World. — Deadline: March 26, 2026. Fee: $18–$50. Prize: $3,000.

item.title: Blank Wall Gallery — Street Photography
item.description: Open call for candid, spontaneous street photography capturing city life. Free to submit. Selected work exhibited at Blank Wall Gallery in Athens, April 24 – May 6, 2026. — Deadline: March 26, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Portfolio 2026
item.description: Juried exhibition featuring cohesive bodies of work. Juror: Natasha Egan (MoCP). Winner eligible for $4,000 High Museum purchase award. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: $75–$105. Prize: $4,000.

item.title: International Color Awards 2026
item.description: 19th annual international color photography competition. Over 235 title awards across 35 categories. Open to professional and amateur photographers. Winners announced at online Photoshow May 30, 2026. Sister competition to the Black & White Spider Awards. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: $30–$35. Prize: $5,000.

item.title: The Idle Class — Photography Issue
item.description: Open call for photographers of all genres to submit work for the upcoming Photography Issue of The Idle Class Magazine. Submit via email with name, description, and files to editorial@idleclassmag.com. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Solo Statement — Doesn't Play Well with Others
item.description: One-night solo takeover of Bushwick Gallery in Brooklyn — a full transformation of the space by a single artist. No shared walls, no compromise. All mediums welcome including photography, installation, performance, and digital. No prior gallery experience required. Submit artist statement (150 words), creative vision for the space, 3–5 recent work images, and two artistic influences. Gallery provides professional photography, press release, and promotional support. Exhibition April 17, 2026. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: $25. Prize: Solo exhibition.

item.title: The Woman Artist Award — 6th Edition
item.description: Juried award for women artists working in any visual arts medium including photography. Winner receives $500 cash prize, glass trophy, interview feature in hardcover coffee table book, website interview, one-year portfolio feature on Women in Arts Network (global directory for women artists), and one-year subscription to Arts to Hearts print + digital magazine. No specific theme — submit your best work. 6th edition. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: $35. Prize: $500.

item.title: COLOR Photography Exhibit
item.description: Exploring color as one of the most powerful storytelling tools. Bold, subtle, vibrant, or muted approaches welcome. Tucson, AZ. — Deadline: March 28, 2026. Fee: $40–$45. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Provoke USA — Open Call
item.description: Open call for a photography zine inspired by the Japanese Provoke movement — destabilizing certainty and revealing a world beyond conventional language. International submissions welcome. No AI-generated images. Submit via email with Instagram handle. — Deadline: March 28, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Prix Révélation SAIF x La Kabine 2026
item.description: Award supporting emerging contemporary photography. €2,000 prize plus exhibition during Festival OFF Arles. 30 finalists projected at La Nuit de l'Émergence with €100 each. Open to professional photographers of all nationalities, 18+. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: €5 minimum (membership). Prize: €2,000.

item.title: Inspired by Classics — Golden Duck Gallery
item.description: International open call for contemporary art engaging with classical art traditions. Study copies, homages, and modern interpretations welcome. Physical exhibition in Budapest, online exhibition in Vienna and New York. 3 artists exhibit free. €1,000 prize fund. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: Free to submit, €100/artwork if selected. Prize: €1,000.

item.title: Contemporary Trends in Beauty - Alternative Processes
item.description: Handcrafted prints using alternative photographic processes. No AI-generated images; final print must be handmade. Juried by Diana H. Bloomfield and Chris Anderson. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: $25. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Centrale Festival Open Call 2026
item.description: Seeking 16 artists under 30 specializing in photography and video art for exhibition in Fano, Italy (June 12-27, 2026). Festival manages curation and setup. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Form Photo Award 2026
item.description: Annual photography prize dedicated to contemporary image-making. Open theme, accepts single images and series. Top 5 winners exhibit at photo basel during Art Basel Week in June 2026. Shortlisted receive digital exhibition and catalogue inclusion. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: €35. Prize: Exhibition at photo basel.

item.title: Head On Photo Festival 2026
item.description: Major international photography festival in Sydney with an AUD 80,000 total prize pool across Portrait, Landscape, and Exposure categories. Blind-judged. Selected work exhibited in print and online during the November 2026 festival. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: AUD 35. Prize: AUD 80,000.

item.title: Paradajs Photo Fest 2026 — Welcome to Paradise
item.description: International photography open call exploring paradise in original, unconventional ways. Submit single photographs or series. Grand Prix winner receives €2,000, a one-month residency in Banská Štiavnica (fall 2026), production support, and a solo exhibition in 2027. 10 finalists shown in group exhibition. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: €10–€15. Prize: €2,000 + residency.

item.title: SUB(SCAPE) — Manifest Gallery Season 22
item.description: Themed group exhibition exploring what lies beneath the visible — structural, psychological, geological, social, or conceptual systems that sustain or destabilize the world above. Open to all media including photography. Submit up to 3 entries for $45, $5 per additional. Every exhibiting artist receives a $50 honorarium. One work selected for a $1,000 Grand Jury Award. Artists receive 70% on sales. Exhibition at Manifest Gallery in Cincinnati, July 10 – August 7, 2026. 22nd season of this nonprofit creative research gallery. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: $45. Prize: $1,000.

item.title: Griffin Museum — Material Work: Toil & Grace
item.description: Exhibition exploring the difficulty and beauty of labor in all forms — artistic, physical, emotional, intellectual, domestic, agricultural, industrial, invisible, and performative. Images of work that feel earned, revealing humanity found in toil. Exhibition at Griffin Museum July 29 – September 6, 2026. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: $45. Prize: None listed.

item.title: BBA Photography Prize 2026
item.description: International photography prize open to all levels and themes. Selected work exhibited at BBA Gallery in Berlin. First prize includes solo exhibition in 2027 and Artsy profile. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: €49. Prize: €1,000.

item.title: Photographers Without Borders Revolutionary Storyteller Grant
item.description: Three recipients worldwide receive $5,000 USD each for impact-driven photography projects focused on environment, land/water protection, decolonized conservation, queer ecology, and climate change. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: PWB membership required. Prize: $5,000.

item.title: Abstract Visions
item.description: Invites abstraction as a way of seeing, sensing, and surviving. Welcomes projects communicating through atmosphere, rhythm, colour, and form. Amsterdam. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: Free (membership required). Prize: None listed.

item.title: Griffin Museum — Self Published Photobook Exhibition 2026
item.description: 16th annual exhibition showcasing up to 50 self-published photobooks at the Griffin Gallery during summer 2026. Submit up to 3 photobook PDFs via CaFE. Jurors: Karen Davis (Davis Orton Gallery) and Crista Dix (Griffin Museum). — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: $45. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Color/less — Cambridge Photography Gallery
item.description: Open call dedicated to color and its absence. Any approach to constructing the color space of the image is welcome — soft pastels, aggressive red, B&W silhouettes. Color (or its absence) must be a key element. Online exhibition April 10–25, 2026. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: Free (£15 if selected). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Griffin Museum — Handmade Photobook Exhibition 2026
item.description: 2nd annual exhibition for handcrafted photobooks where the artist's hand shapes the object itself. Submit handmade photobooks via CaFE. Juror: Caleb Cain Marcus of Luminosity Lab. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: $45. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: HNDL Magazine — PRIDE Issue
item.description: Submissions for the PRIDE issue of HNDL Magazine, an indie publication by and for neurodivergent, disabled, and chronically ill creatives. Accepting art, poetry, creative nonfiction, prose, photography, and zines. Especially seeking candid photography and creative nonfiction. Written pieces max 4 pages, no PDFs. Unpaid — contributors receive a printed copy. — Deadline: March 30, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Contributor's copy.

item.title: Anja Niedringhaus Courage in Photojournalism Award 2026
item.description: Award honoring courageous, high-impact photojournalism by women, nonbinary, and gender-diverse creatives. Submit 12 photographs (6 from 2024–2026, 6 from broader career) plus a 500-word statement. Open to women, nonbinary, and gender non-conforming photojournalists working full-time in journalism. Self-nomination or third-party nomination accepted. Named after Pulitzer Prize-winning photographer Anja Niedringhaus (1965–2014). — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $20,000.

item.title: ZRNO Festival 2026 — Open Call
item.description: International festival of alternative photography. Seeking analog photographers working with alternative and noble processes — cyanotype, wet plate, collodion, and experimental techniques. Single works or cohesive bodies of work welcome. Theme: Unfocus to see. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Atlantic Current — Annual Photo Issue
item.description: Annual photo issue across six categories: Film, Aerial, Portrait, Architecture, Landscape, and Submerged. Open to all photographers. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Check website. Prize: None listed.

item.title: KYOTOGRAPHIE International Portfolio Review 2026
item.description: International portfolio review with world-class experts in Kyoto, April 17–19. Fujifilm Award and new KYOTOGRAPHIE x Dazed Award for emerging photographers. Open to all ages, nationalities, and career levels. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: ¥2,000 application + ¥25,000–¥40,000 if accepted. Prize: ¥100,000 voucher (Fujifilm Award).

item.title: Bibin Photography Magazine #5 — Body, Form & Condition
item.description: Quarterly contemporary photography magazine from Afghanistan. Issue #5 explores the body through formalist reading — volume, surface, and condition. 20 photographs selected per edition. Multiple submissions welcome. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Penumbra Foundation Workspace Residency 2026
item.description: 6–8 week residency in New York City with $7,000 honorarium. Access to comprehensive photographic facilities including darkrooms, digital labs, and studio space. Juried by Makeda Best, Natasha Chuk, and Walead Beshty. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $7,000.

item.title: Penumbra Foundation Risograph Publication Residency
item.description: Residency to produce a small edition risograph photobook at Penumbra's facilities in NYC. No prior risograph experience required. Juried by Catherine McKinley, Joshua Chuang, and Travis Shaffer. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Somewhere I Have Never Travelled — Group Exhibition
item.description: Group exhibition exploring place as memory and memory as place. All mediums welcome including performance and installation. Exhibition runs July 12–September 12, 2026 in Harvard Square, Cambridge, MA. Artists responsible for shipping. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Field Notes — Aurea Photogallery
item.description: Exhibition seeking photographs as visual observations — moments collected while moving through the world. Landscapes, street photography, portraits, and everyday details. One-month online exhibition with catalogue and permanent archive. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free to submit, €30 if selected. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Life Framer — Black & White
item.description: Monthly photography competition judged by Léa Thouin. All genres welcome. Winners exhibited at international galleries in New York, Tokyo, Milan, and Arles. $24,000 in total cash prizes across the year. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: $20–$40. Prize: $24,000.
